definitions.explanation: a feeling of dissatisfaction; a sense that something is lacking or insufficient; wanting more

examples.japanese: ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なくて→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧{物足|ものた}りなさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I felt it was lacking because the portion was small.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結末|けつまつ}→結末：15091_ketsumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物足|ものた}りなさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: The ending left me wanting more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{物足|ものた}りなさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I feel the explanation is insufficient.

notes:
{物足|ものた}りなさ is a noun derived from the i-adjective ⟦{物足|ものた}りない→物足りない：06627_monotarinai⟧ (insufficient, not enough, unsatisfying) by adding the suffix ～さ to create a noun expressing the quality or feeling.

FORMS:
- ⟦{物足|ものた}りない→物足りない：06627_monotarinai⟧ (i-adjective: unsatisfying)
- {物足|ものた}りなさ (noun: feeling of insufficiency)
- ⟦{物足|ものた}りなく→物足りない：06627_monotarinai⟧ (adverb: unsatisfyingly)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {物足|ものた}りなさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel something is lacking)
- {物足|ものた}りなさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (a feeling of wanting more remains)
- {物足|ものた}りなさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to sense insufficiency)

USAGE:
- Food portions
- Entertainment endings
- Explanations or information
- Relationships or interactions
- Work accomplishments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ (dissatisfaction - stronger negative)
- ⟦{満足感|まんぞくかん}→満足感：15988_manzokukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{欠如|けつじょ}→欠如：13208_ketsujo⟧ (lack of satisfaction - formal)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday and written contexts.
